command: uv run --locked jupyter nbconvert --execute --to notebook --inplace --ExecutePreprocessor.timeout=3600 notebooks/11_formatting_rule.ipynb

ensemble.tie: grid order; fewer within .0005 of best path

config.hard_probability_mapping: fixed arctan mapping of the pre-offset ensemble margin: flagged [.99,1), others (0,.99); check observed score order without labels

nb.ratio: log normalized class token frequency ratio; training only

config.reference: eligible unlabeled; no-blank specialists exclude literal blank lines; store population mean/std; never normalize test batches
config.reuse: reference and rule-all share identical learned fit/reference stats; only rule score differs
config.rule: literal two consecutive newlines; zero human matches in original current fit partition before specialist filtering
config.soft_probability_mapping: sigmoid of the averaged offset margins; not claimed calibrated
